title: The Swiss Lever Watch
description: Interactive anatomies of two machines in one plate series. Tab 1 - the Swiss lever watch: wind the crown, follow the barrel's energy through the gear train, watch the pallet fork spend it one half-tooth at a time, 28,800 beats an hour. Tab 2 - the bicycle drivetrain: push 172.5 mm cranks, follow the chain from the 50-tooth ring to the 15-tooth cog, feel the freewheel pawls let you coast. Live gauges, true numbers, honest simplifications.
